title: Authorship Cluster: RAG for AI-Generated Content Survey
summary: This community consists of the ten authors of the 2024 survey paper 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for AI-Generated Content: A Survey'. The cluster is defined entirely by the 'AUTHORED_BY' relationships linking each individual to the central paper entity. The group represents the collaborative research team behind this specific work on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in the context of AI-generated content.
key_findings: The central entity is the paper 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for AI-Generated Content: A Survey', published in 2024.
The paper has exactly ten identified authors: Penghao Zhao, Hailin Zhang, Qinhan Yu, Zhengren Wang, Yunteng Geng, Fangcheng Fu, Ling Yang, Wentao Zhang, Jie Jiang, and Bin Cui.
All internal relationships in this community are of the type 'AUTHORED_BY', connecting the paper to its respective authors.
The paper is associated with the arXiv identifier 2402.19473 and is categorized under cs.CV (Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition).
Penghao Zhao is listed as the first author in the provided reference citation.
The community contains no other types of entities (such as methods, datasets, or other papers) or relationships beyond the authorship links.
